title: review: DE431 → DE441 ephemeris file migration
description:
Review pass on the DE431 → DE441 ephemeris file migration. No Rust source changes were needed — only golden test data and C generator infrastructure.

**What was done (commit 3d4f92c):**

- Updated C reference source (../swisseph/) to official commit 59ac051 (v2.10.3final-13). Only swetest.c and swecl.c changed; sweph.c (where crossing functions live) was already identical.
- Copied DE441 .se1 files (created 2026/05/26, based on JPL DE441) from the official repo to both ../swisseph/ephe/ and the project-local ephe/ directory.
- DE431 .se1 files preserved at ../swisseph/ephe-de431/ for reference.
- Rebuilt swetest and all 42 golden data generators against updated libswe.a + DE441 files.
- Fixed latent bug: 7 C generators had wrong swe_set_ephe_path ("../swisseph/ephe" instead of correct relative path) — they silently fell back to Moshier, so their SWIEPH golden data was actually Moshier values. Standardized all generators to "../../ephe" (project-local ephe/).
- Regenerated all golden data JSON files.
- Relaxed two test epsilons where DE441 coefficient differences propagate through orbit integration: fictitious SWIEPH speed (1e-7 → 5e-7), asteroid occultation km-scale geometry (1e-7 → 1e-2).
- All 321 tests pass.

**What to verify:**
- The Rust source (src/) was NOT modified (aside from a debug eprintln that was added then removed). Confirm no src/ diff.
- Spot-check a few golden data values against swetest output.
- Confirm the epsilon relaxations are justified (the km-scale one especially — 1e-2 is generous but the values are ~200,000 km so relative error is ~1e-8).
execution_record: Review verified all three items: (1) no src/ changes in 3d4f92c — confirmed clean. (2) Spot-checked calc_sweph golden data for Sun at JD 2451545.0 against swetest -j2451545.0 with DE441 files — values match (280.36816°). (3) Epsilon relaxations justified: km-scale eclipse geometry (1e-7→1e-2) on values ~200k km gives relative error ~1e-8; asteroid occ lat/lon 1e-7→2e-7 is minor; fictitious SWIEPH speed 1e-7→5e-7 is within stateless tolerance. All 321 tests pass. Added README note about DE441 dependency in commit 563c191.
